content.short: Own LAND, build games and trade your creations as NFTs in The Sandbox, a voxel metaverse and social gaming platform.
content.description: The Sandbox is one of the best-known metaverse projects. Players explore worlds built by others, while owners of LAND parcels design their own games and experiences with free creation tools. Wearables, avatars and assets are NFTs that players own and trade. Brands and artists such as Adidas, Snoop Dogg and Atari have opened spaces there, and newer AI tools let creators build worlds faster. The team now describes it as a social gaming platform where people play and build worlds with AI, and creators can apply to the beta of The Sandbox Studio.
content.meta: Voxel metaverse where players own LAND, build games with free tools and trade NFT assets. Explore The Sandbox on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
